name: @js-joda/timezone
description: iana tzdb timezone bindings for js-joda

scripts.test: npm run build-source && NODE_ENV=test npm run with-source -- npx mocha --timeout 5000 --require @babel/register ./test/*Test.js ./test/**/*Test.js
scripts.test-coverage: npm run build-source && NODE_ENV=test COVERAGE=1 npm run with-source -- npx nyc --report-dir=build/coverage --reporter=lcov --reporter html npx mocha --timeout 5000 --require @babel/register --reporter progress ./test/*Test.js ./test/**/*Test.js ./test/**/**/*Test.js
scripts.test-browser: npm run build-source && NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' npm run with-source -- npx karma start karma.conf.ts --reporters=dots --single-run
scripts.test-ci: npm run build-dist && npm run test && npm run test-browser && npm run test-ts-definitions && npm run test-coverage
scripts.build-dist: npm run build-source && NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' npm run with-source -- npx rollup -c rollup.config.ts

author: pithu
